thresholds.title: Elevated stuck events
thresholds.detail: Stuck count is high relative to run hours.
thresholds.action: Clear clutter, check cliff sensors, inspect wheels.

thresholds.title: Frequent scrubs
thresholds.detail: Robot is scrubbing often (debris / carpet edges).

thresholds.title: High lifetime run hours
thresholds.action: Inspect brushes, casters, and filter; replace wear parts as needed.

thresholds.title: Bin full
thresholds.action: Empty the bin before the next mission.
